answer:
Verdict: no

Over the whole trace (offsets 0–30,694 ms), the sampler was preempted only **2 times**, for **0.017 ms total**; its longest preempted wait was **0.008 ms**. The CPU-occupancy finding names no higher-priority real-time thread: the identified non-idle holders had normal priority (nice 0), and the CPU was idle or handling interrupts for most of the sampler’s runnable time. The **5,315** wake-up waits are not preemptions.
